## Description

Curves / surfaces have degree or segment count exceeding what the target system can read — typically a degree-9 univariate `B_SPLINE_CURVE_WITH_KNOTS` with only ~10 Bezier-style clamped control points, or a degree-9-by-degree-7 `B_SPLINE_SURFACE_WITH_KNOTS` with rank-deficient control nets (every U-row identical). A degree-restriction healer re-fits with a target degree, segment cap and continuity. A historical typo bug caused fits not to achieve requested continuity.

## Reproducer recipe

STEP with `B_SPLINE_CURVE_WITH_KNOTS` degree 9 or `B_SPLINE_SURFACE_WITH_KNOTS` (9,7); pass through `ShapeCustom_BSplineRestriction` targeting degree 3 with C2 continuity.

## Expected kernel behavior

heal — re-fit within stated tolerance; report deviation; refuse output if requested continuity cannot be met.

- allowed: `reject, heal`
